title: TranscriptSegment
description: A single speaker-attributed, timestamped unit of transcribed speech. Produced by the speech pipeline (STT + diarization) and persisted IMMEDIATELY — never buffered to session end. This is the source of truth. See design §11, §13.

session_id.description: GD session this segment belongs to.

candidate_id.description: Speaker resolved by diarization / speaker mapping.

start.description: Segment start time in seconds from session start.

end.description: Segment end time in seconds from session start. Must be >= start.

examples.text: I think AI will create new categories of employment.
